ideas.title: Secret-safe execution and public-log containment
ideas.priorityRationale: Critical observed leak outranks speculative optimizations.
ideas.resultOrDeferral: Actions command-file/token variables removed before native execution; command contents private; four confirmed exposed log archives deleted. Rotation still required.
ideas.confidenceBasis: Observed local defect or contract with regression checks

ideas.title: Honor the OpenClaw/native CLI instruction contract
ideas.priorityRationale: Configured skills are of little use if policy never reaches the worker.
ideas.resultOrDeferral: Explicit system-prompt file transport; Claude appends its policy and Codex/OpenCode receive supplemental context while retaining native instructions.
ideas.confidenceBasis: Observed local defect or contract with regression checks

ideas.title: Bound turn lifetime and reap runaway native descendants
ideas.priorityRationale: Gateway/client cancellation does not necessarily cancel a remote child.
ideas.resultOrDeferral: Absolute turn deadline, bounded repository lease wait, process-group termination and expired-deadline rejection. Immediate cross-Gateway cancellation remains a limitation.
ideas.confidenceBasis: Observed local defect or contract with regression checks

ideas.title: Small provenance-bearing recovery packets
ideas.priorityRationale: Recovery should inspect a few relevant facts before opening large histories.
ideas.resultOrDeferral: Per-run context.json contains same-project recent receipts, retained paths, curated surfaces and lean runtime policy; bytes recorded. No blanket token-savings claim.
ideas.confidenceBasis: Observed local defect or contract with regression checks

ideas.title: Evidence-based publication and truthful recovery semantics
ideas.priorityRationale: Repeated submodule cleanup failures and unchecked report types were real defects.
ideas.resultOrDeferral: Validate completion types/URLs/size, reject reported failing checks and non-descendant commits, retain submodule worktrees without false run failure.
ideas.confidenceBasis: Observed local defect or contract with regression checks

ideas.title: Explicit provider choice with private, bounded telemetry
ideas.priorityRationale: Operators need route evidence without exposing shell contents or guessing headroom.
ideas.resultOrDeferral: Manual codex/claude/deepseek selection, requested/observed route, adapter/wrapper revision and numeric usage; no ambiguous mutation retry.
ideas.confidenceBasis: Observed local defect or contract with regression checks

ideas.title: Skill lifecycle validation, scope and synchronization
ideas.priorityRationale: New skills were not consistently linked and authoring material was discoverable as runtime skills.
ideas.resultOrDeferral: Focused OpenClaw skill, metadata/link doctor, owner-preserving synchronization across three Claude profiles and other runtimes; authoring/template files removed from runtime discovery.
ideas.confidenceBasis: Observed local defect or contract with regression checks

ideas.title: Derived fleet health and repeat-failure diagnosis
ideas.priorityRationale: A healthy daemon is not proof that projects are making progress.
ideas.resultOrDeferral: Read-only GitHub/local health report, actual workflow state, recent successes/failure streaks, secret-availability boolean and failure fingerprints; no extra model/timer/issue spam.
ideas.confidenceBasis: Observed local defect or contract with regression checks

ideas.title: Portfolio-aware onboarding and verification hints
ideas.priorityRationale: The fifth project exists, and these repositories do not share one application shape.
ideas.resultOrDeferral: Discover and onboard bricklabor.com; preserve existing runner-group approvals; curate project surfaces and verification hints for all five; pin obvious callers on main.
ideas.confidenceBasis: Observed local defect or contract with regression checks

ideas.title: Repository-scoped retrieval with scored excerpts
ideas.priorityRationale: Improve existing FTS before paying for vectors.
ideas.resultOrDeferral: Deferred: current packets already bound initial recovery; measure retrieval misses first.
ideas.confidenceBasis: Plausible opportunity; benefit not measured on this fleet

ideas.title: Rehydrate local memory from retained GitHub artifacts
ideas.priorityRationale: A new host should reconstruct useful derived context.
ideas.resultOrDeferral: Deferred: machine bootstrap and git suffice today; artifact retention is only 90 days.
ideas.confidenceBasis: Plausible opportunity; benefit not measured on this fleet

ideas.title: A single-controller Cua desktop lease
ideas.priorityRationale: Parallel repository work should not race keyboard and mouse.
ideas.resultOrDeferral: Deferred: document one-controller convention; no evidence of concurrent GUI jobs yet.
ideas.confidenceBasis: Plausible opportunity; benefit not measured on this fleet

ideas.title: Deterministic per-surface verification registry
ideas.priorityRationale: Map affected files to proven package commands.
ideas.resultOrDeferral: Deferred: hints implemented first; test commands need validation within each product before automation.
ideas.confidenceBasis: Plausible opportunity; benefit not measured on this fleet

ideas.title: Cross-project dependency and deployment graph
ideas.priorityRationale: Understand upstream site/control-plane relationships.
ideas.resultOrDeferral: Deferred: discovered stacks are not sufficient evidence of actual dependency edges.
ideas.confidenceBasis: Plausible opportunity; benefit not measured on this fleet

ideas.title: Independent review only for high-impact changes
ideas.priorityRationale: Use fresh context when review value exceeds extra compute.
ideas.resultOrDeferral: Deferred: avoid mandatory reviewer cost for every fifteen-minute turn.
ideas.confidenceBasis: Plausible opportunity; benefit not measured on this fleet

ideas.title: Account headroom and reset UI
ideas.priorityRationale: Expose safe router observations with timestamps.
ideas.resultOrDeferral: Deferred: preserve unknown/stale states; avoid undocumented subscription APIs.
ideas.confidenceBasis: Plausible opportunity; benefit not measured on this fleet

ideas.title: A context-quality A/B evaluation corpus
ideas.priorityRationale: Measure completion quality and overhead before claiming savings.
ideas.resultOrDeferral: Deferred: regression contracts added now; representative multi-project trials need a baseline dataset.
ideas.confidenceBasis: Plausible opportunity; benefit not measured on this fleet

ideas.title: Compatibility canaries before automatic runtime upgrades
ideas.priorityRationale: An upstream tool release can alter the backend contract.
ideas.resultOrDeferral: Deferred: installed runtime integration is verified now; automatic upgrade service adds another failure surface.
ideas.confidenceBasis: Plausible opportunity; benefit not measured on this fleet

ideas.title: Native session resume with provenance checks
ideas.priorityRationale: Reuse history only when workspace/policy identity matches.
ideas.resultOrDeferral: Deferred: current backend deliberately uses fresh sessions and durable files; unsafe resume could mix worktrees.
ideas.confidenceBasis: Plausible opportunity; benefit not measured on this fleet

ideas.title: Provider-assisted credential rotation
ideas.priorityRationale: Containment alone cannot revoke leaked credentials.
ideas.resultOrDeferral: Deferred and required follow-up: needs each provider account; do not automate unverified destructive rotation.
ideas.confidenceBasis: Plausible opportunity; benefit not measured on this fleet

ideas.title: Proxmox full-disk backups and guest-agent verification
ideas.priorityRationale: Git snapshots omit credentials, databases and personal data.
ideas.resultOrDeferral: Deferred: host-level backup policy requires Proxmox access; machine README makes limits explicit.
ideas.confidenceBasis: Plausible opportunity; benefit not measured on this fleet

ideas.title: Signed skill releases and dependency attestations
ideas.priorityRationale: Mutable shared skills are a privileged input.
ideas.resultOrDeferral: Deferred: SHA-pinned workflow callers plus trusted git source are sufficient current boundary.
ideas.confidenceBasis: Plausible opportunity; benefit not measured on this fleet

ideas.title: Control UI search over canonical run artifacts
ideas.priorityRationale: Let humans inspect reports without opening each project.
ideas.resultOrDeferral: Deferred: user excluded website publishing; current local UI remains operational.
ideas.confidenceBasis: Plausible opportunity; benefit not measured on this fleet

ideas.title: Event-driven targeted turns alongside cadence
ideas.priorityRationale: Respond sooner to actionable changes.
ideas.resultOrDeferral: Deferred: user explicitly wants one turn for every enabled repository on each tick.
ideas.confidenceBasis: Plausible opportunity; benefit not measured on this fleet

ideas.title: Global token/headroom portfolio allocation
ideas.priorityRationale: Allocate scarce subscription headroom across projects.
ideas.resultOrDeferral: Deferred: user explicitly ruled out sophisticated slot allocation for now.
ideas.confidenceBasis: Plausible opportunity; benefit not measured on this fleet

ideas.title: Cloudflare AI Search / vector memory
ideas.priorityRationale: May help when corpus scale/retrieval quality justifies it.
ideas.resultOrDeferral: Deferred: no measured need beyond local file/FTS search; no new Cloudflare assets.
ideas.confidenceBasis: Plausible opportunity; benefit not measured on this fleet

ideas.title: Per-job tenant containers and separate OS users
ideas.priorityRationale: Real tenant boundaries exceed environment filtering.
ideas.resultOrDeferral: Deferred: this is an explicitly trusted-owner persistent desktop; full isolation is a larger redesign.
ideas.confidenceBasis: Plausible opportunity; benefit not measured on this fleet

ideas.title: Learn reusable skill improvements from accepted run outcomes
ideas.priorityRationale: Convert repeat errors into narrow guidance and behavioral evals.
ideas.resultOrDeferral: Deferred: avoid treating agent self-reports as training truth; gather verified examples first.
ideas.confidenceBasis: Plausible opportunity; benefit not measured on this fleet

ideas.title: Race multiple native providers for each coding task
ideas.priorityRationale: Parallel answers can reduce latency for read-only questions.
ideas.resultOrDeferral: Rejected for routine mutating turns: duplicate costs and conflicting edits outweigh unproven benefit.
ideas.confidenceBasis: Plausible opportunity; benefit not measured on this fleet

ideas.title: Autonomous payment/marketing production mutations
ideas.priorityRationale: Business integrations could eventually connect to orchestrated work.
ideas.resultOrDeferral: Rejected for this setup task: real payments, messages and campaign changes need specific authorized product flows.
ideas.confidenceBasis: Plausible opportunity; benefit not measured on this fleet
